criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: HealthIA combines case-specific five-question clinical blocks generated by Gemini through a demand-driven Google ADK coordinator, accumulated question/answer memory, an AI decision to ask more only when material or close with patient-facing orientation, a patient-owned longitudinal record, multimodal clinical-result interpretation, a provenance-linked clinical twin and conversational retrieval of older requested studies. The live synthetic proof now demonstrates that the first and second clinical blocks are genuinely generated and differ while preserving accumulated memory. The remaining utility gap is one judge-visible Taskmaster mission that performs an action to a verified external or durable outcome and reaches an explicit completed closure state.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: The system now has typed patient-scoped longitudinal state, deterministic safety, scrypt patient accounts, signed HttpOnly sessions, patient-scoped SSE, guarded Gemini calls, real per-request Google ADK tool execution with mandatory interview and safety tools, no permanent polling, signed device identity, atomic result-plus-original evidence commits, and synchronous mission-state propagation to the browser. The encrypted live workflow proved a secure session round-trip, patient-scoped write, auditable ADK tool trajectory, two distinct patient identities with cross-patient isolation, logout/re-login restoration, and multimodal original/twin round-trip. The remaining architecture point is reserved for real Cloud Run/Firestore/GCS persistence and restart/isolation proof.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: Two independent evidence paths are now green. The encrypted live workflow made a real stateless Gemini preflight and then passed twelve strict authenticated checks covering Gemini/ADK adaptive questioning, accumulated memory, AI orientation, auditable tool trajectory, multimodal PDF interpretation, original/twin round-trip, two-patient isolation and logout/re-login restoration. Separately, GitHub Actions run 31206263212 on SHA 05f9a8c36a7bc0b33fb8bf327be8b46a5b38b207 passed pytest, fourteen full-system workflows, Chromium E2E, compileall, smoke, Judge Omega, JavaScript and PowerShell checks, release build/verification and pytest again from the extracted ZIP. Remaining readiness gaps are real Cloud deployment evidence, a closed-loop Taskmaster outcome, the unedited demo and final judge package.

critical_blockers.statement: Authenticated two-patient isolation, secure session round-trip and logout/re-login restoration are now proven in the live GitHub runtime, but Cloud Run restart/reconnect and Firestore/GCS isolation remain unproven.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Two isolated synthetic identities plus Cloud Run restart/reconnect proof showing one identity cannot read, download or sync into the other after a deployed revision restart.

critical_blockers.statement: The system can collect, reason over, interpret, persist, retrieve and follow longitudinal evidence, but the submission still needs one Taskmaster-style action that reaches a verified external or durable outcome and closes its mission.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: A correlated end-to-end mission with evidence IDs, tool action, durable outcome, patient/external feedback and completed closure state.

critical_blockers.statement: Cloud Run, Firestore and GCS have a strict verification path, but the repository authentication probe proved that no supported Google Cloud Project ID/authentication secret is currently configured in GitHub Secrets.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Configure GCP Project ID plus WIF/service account or credentials, then preserve Cloud Run URL/revision, deployment/cloud-proof-latest.json, Firestore update, GCS generation and live Gemini/ADK evidence.

critical_blockers.statement: The architecture, live proof and verified release candidate exist, but the unedited demo video and final submission package are not assembled.
